title: theobroma cacao subsp. sphaerocarpum
intro: Theobroma cacao subsp. sphaerocarpum, commonly known as the wild cacao tree or sphaerocarpum cacao, is a subspecies of the cacao tree native to the Amazon rainforest. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting weight management due to its high antioxidant and flavonoid content. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Theobroma cacao subsp. sphaerocarpum include flavanols, flavan-3-ols, and xanthines, which are also found in other cacao species and have been reported to have various health benefits.
